title: Programming 1
institution: Imam Muhammad Ibn Saud Islamic University
environment: Java JDK, Visual Studio Code, Java Extension Pack, terminal
learningOutcomes: Explain how Java source code is written, compiled, and executed with the JDK, bytecode, and JVM.
Use VS Code, the terminal, and beginner debugging habits to create and run Java programs.
Write programs using variables, primitive data types, String, constants, Scanner input, output, expressions, casting, and formatted text.
Use relational and logical expressions with if, if/else, else-if, nested if, the conditional operator, and switch.
Use while, for, do-while, nested loops, break, continue, and return in beginner-level control-flow problems.
Create and process one-dimensional arrays and two-dimensional matrices using indexes, traversal, search, counting, totals, averages, and min/max operations.
Combine input, selection, loops, arrays, and calculations into small integrated Java programs.

weeks.title: Java, JVM/JRE/JDK, and First Program
weeks.module: Official Chapters 1-2: Java introduction and development environment
weeks.learn: Programming concepts, instruction types, Java characteristics, platform independence, source code, compiler, bytecode, JVM, JRE, JDK, Java SE context, VS Code/JDK setup, program structure, class, main, statements, comments, print/println, escape sequences, compile/run workflow, and basic error types.
weeks.resources: Course specification, CH1 Introduction to Java and JVM, CH2 Java Development Environment, CS230 old Java intro slides, Java Full Course intro transcript
weeks.milestone: Create, compile, run, modify, and debug HelloCS0122.java in VS Code.

weeks.title: Variables, Data Types, Constants, and Console I/O
weeks.module: Official Chapters 3-4: basic syntax, variables, data types, and I/O
weeks.learn: Identifiers, naming rules, keywords, memory spaces, primitive data types, String, literals, declaration, assignment, initialization, constants, naming conventions, type compatibility, standard output, whitespace in strings, Scanner input, Scanner methods, input mistakes, value tracing, and brief JOptionPane/parsing demonstration.
weeks.buildsOn: Week 1 Java program structure and terminal workflow
weeks.resources: Course specification, CH3 Basic Syntax Variables Data Types Operators, CH4 Input/Output and Basic Formatting, CS230 variables/input slides, Java Full Course variables and input transcript
weeks.milestone: Submit a console-based StudentProfile.java program using Scanner.

weeks.title: Expressions, Operators, and Casting
weeks.module: Official Chapter 2 Operations in Java, represented through CH3/CH4 materials
weeks.learn: Arithmetic expressions, binary and unary arithmetic, assignment operators, increment/decrement, precedence, associativity, integer division, modulus, textual operations/string concatenation, formatted output, implicit numeric conversion, explicit casting, character numeric codes, expression tracing, relational/logical operations as boolean expressions, and common operator/type errors. Conditional control flow is deferred.
weeks.buildsOn: Week 2 variables, data types, and console input/output
weeks.resources: Course specification, CH3 operations/expression slides, CH4 console I/O and formatting, CS230 operators/debugging slides, Java Full Course expressions transcript
weeks.milestone: Build ShoppingBill.java using expressions, casting, printf, and boolean expressions without conditionals.

weeks.title: Conditional Statements - Consolidation and Advanced Selection
weeks.learn: Boolean conditions, relational and logical operators, if, if/else, else-if ladder, nested if, braces and blocks, dangling else, conditional operator, switch, case, break, default, and validation patterns.
weeks.buildsOn: Weeks 1-3 variables, input, expressions, and boolean expressions
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH5 Control Structures Selection, CS230 selection examples
weeks.milestone: Build a menu-driven Scanner program using if/else, switch, and validation.

weeks.title: Loops I - while and for
weeks.learn: Repetition, initialization, condition, body, update, iteration, while loops, for loops, counter-controlled loops, sentinel-controlled loops, running totals, input validation, loop tracing, and infinite-loop debugging.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH6 Control Structure Looping, CS230 loop tracing examples
weeks.milestone: Create a loop-based number statistics program using Scanner.

weeks.title: Loops II - do-while, Nested Loops, break, continue, return
weeks.module: Official Chapter 4: looping and jumping statements
weeks.learn: Pre-test vs post-test loops, do-while menus, nested loops, row/column repetition, multiplication-table grids, pattern generation, break, continue, and return as beginner-level jumping statements.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH6 Control Structure Looping, CS230 break/continue examples, CH7 return reference
weeks.milestone: Build an interactive repeating menu using do-while, switch, validation, break, and continue.

weeks.title: Midterm Review - Consolidation and Problem Solving
weeks.module: Official assessment timing: Midterm in Week 7
weeks.learn: Cumulative review of variables, input, expressions, selection, loops, tracing, debugging, code completion, and problem-solving workflow.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification assessment timing and Chapters 1-4 review
weeks.milestone: Complete integrated review practice without publishing graded exam answers.

weeks.title: Arrays I - One-Dimensional Arrays
weeks.module: Official Chapter 5: arrays and matrix concept
weeks.learn: Array concept, definition, one-dimensional arrays, declaration, creation, initialization, length, indexes, zero-based indexing, accessing elements, updating elements, traversal with for, Scanner with arrays, and ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH10 Arrays, CS230 array memory/index examples
weeks.milestone: Create a student grades analyzer using one-dimensional arrays.

weeks.title: Arrays II - One-Dimensional Array Operations
weeks.module: Official Chapter 5: operations on one-dimensional arrays
weeks.learn: Traversal, sum, average, min, max, counting, searching, copying, reversing, simple frequency/count problems, and integrated loops plus conditions plus arrays.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH10 Arrays, CS230 traversal/search examples
weeks.milestone: Build a temperature analyzer using array operations.

weeks.title: Two-Dimensional Arrays and Matrices
weeks.module: Official Chapter 5: multidimensional arrays and matrices
weeks.learn: Matrix concept, two-dimensional arrays, rows, columns, [row][column] access, initialization, updating elements, nested-loop traversal, row totals, column totals, overall totals, averages, and matrix visualization.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification, CH10 Arrays, CS230 two-dimensional array examples
weeks.milestone: Create and process a two-dimensional matrix; prepare the group project checkpoint.

weeks.title: Arrays III - Integrated Project
weeks.module: Official Chapter 5 plus group project timing
weeks.learn: Integrated beginner project using input, selection, loops, one-dimensional arrays, calculations, average, min/max, pass/fail count, search, menu repetition, and project testing.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification group project timing, CH10 Arrays, CS230 integrated problem-solving examples
weeks.milestone: Complete a group project checkpoint with data plan, menu operations, tests, and explanation.

weeks.title: Final Lab Preparation - Integrated Coding Practice
weeks.module: Official assessment timing: Final Lab Exam in Week 12
weeks.learn: Integrated practice with variables, Scanner, expressions, selection, loops, arrays, tracing, debugging, test tables, and lab-readiness workflow.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification assessment timing and Chapters 1-5 review
weeks.milestone: Complete final lab readiness practice without publishing confidential assessment content.

weeks.title: Consolidation and Project Completion
weeks.learn: Cumulative problem solving, pseudocode, project polishing, testing, explanation, debugging, and optional enrichment kept subordinate to the required CS0122 scope.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification Chapters 1-5, CS230 pseudocode and review ideas
weeks.milestone: Polish an integrated project and explain the data, decisions, loops, arrays, and tests.

weeks.title: Course Completion and Cumulative Practice
weeks.learn: Course concept map, cumulative tracing, search with arrays, break review, debugging review, final programming habits, and optional next-step orientation.
weeks.resources: CS0122 course specification Chapters 1-5, CS230 review and trace examples
weeks.milestone: Complete cumulative review practice and a final concept map.
